items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies injective, surjective and bijective morphisms of an abelian category with monomorphisms, epimorphisms and isomorphisms (statement lines 869-877). The proof is a complete argument: the first equivalence is obtained by writing the kernel as the object representing the functor of kernels of the induced maps on Hom-sets (proof lines 880-884); the second is the same argument (proof line 885); and the third combines the first two with the identification of the source with the coimage and the target with the image of a morphism that is both injective and surjective (proof lines 886-891). The non-formal content is the representability translation. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
